block.pattern: ^\#\ notice\-route\ managed\ v1\ flush=1m\n[\s\S]*\#\ notice\-route\ managed\ end\n?(?![\s\S])
block.description: The managed block as it is in the crontab after the command, or would be with --dry-run: the line '# notice-route managed v1 flush=1m' first and '# notice-route managed end' last.

env_file.description: Absolute path from cron.env_file; null when unset.
